models.summary: A 27B ternary-quantized language model compressed to 5.9GB that runs on consumer hardware while retaining 98.2% of full-precision performance.
A 552-billion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model that processes images and text with efficient token-level activation and million-token context support.
A 27-billion-parameter vision-language model supporting images and videos with flexible thinking for complex multi-step reasoning and agentic tasks.
A 3-billion-parameter music generation model that creates complete songs from lyrics and style, with editable scores for melody and chord control.
A 29-billion-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model with only 4B active parameters per token, native 256K context, and tool-calling support for agents.
A non-uniformly quantized GGUF version of Qwen3.8-27B that allocates per-tensor precision for efficient multimodal inference on CPU and GPU.
A fine-tuned variant of Qwen3.8-27B that reduces reasoning tokens by 58% while maintaining performance and achieving 1.95x speedup.
A diffusion-based model supporting multiple modalities including image-to-video, text-to-video, video transformation, and audio-video generation.
A 1.5-billion-parameter model optimized for structured generation on Apple Silicon, delivering 5-7x speedup for JSON schema and classification tasks.
A fine-tuned Qwen3.8-27B variant that reduces thinking tokens by up to 90% while maintaining reasoning quality and achieving higher benchmark scores.
